instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\plate_raw.dxf. Import plate_raw.dxf. Draw a closed chamfered plate outline through vertices (10,0), (170,0), (180,10), (180,70), (170,80), (10,80), (0,70), and (0,10). Add four diameter 10 holes at (30,20), (150,20), (30,60), and (150,60), and add text ACAD-23. Use OUTLINE for the chamfered plate, HOLE for holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
